quarterly_data.signal: Western Digital's fiscal 2026 10-K reports three unnamed customers accounting for 16%, 15% and 13% of net revenue in fiscal 2026 (year ended July 3, 2026), versus 17%, 12% and 10% in fiscal 2025 and no single 10% customer in fiscal 2024; its top 10 customers were 73%, 68% and 55% of net revenue in those years, and the Cloud end market accounted for 89% of fiscal 2026 net revenue. The company sells to hyperscale cloud service providers, neoclouds, computer manufacturers and OEMs, resellers, distributors and retailers.
quarterly_data.figure: 16%, 15%, 13% of fiscal 2026 net revenue; top 10 customers 73%; Cloud end market 89%
